run_split_librilight: run the split.py script to split LibriLight audio files into nested subsets by genre
get_stats_dataset: get statistics including seconds per genre, files per genre, SNR, unique speakers, and books from metadata JSON files
subselect_genre_balanced: subselect a fraction of audio files while maintaining genre balance using a divisor to control subset size
get_genre2time_audio: get a mapping of each genre to its total audio duration in seconds from metadata JSON files
get_fname2json_metadata: read a list of metadata JSON file paths and return a dictionary mapping each path to its parsed JSON data
